requirements.statement: A Merchant can register an account and submit business/KYC details

criteria.must: A new Merchant can submit business name, owner name, country, currency and contact details
After submission the merchant's KYC status is pending

requirements.statement: A Platform Admin can review and approve or reject a merchant's onboarding application

criteria.must: A Platform Admin can see a list of merchants with pending KYC status
A Platform Admin can approve a pending merchant, setting its KYC status to approved
A Platform Admin can reject a pending merchant, setting its KYC status to rejected

requirements.statement: A Merchant can generate a payment link or QR code for a specific amount

criteria.must: A Merchant can create a payment link by entering an amount
The generated payment link includes a shareable QR code or URL

requirements.statement: A Customer can pay a merchant's payment link using mobile money

criteria.must: Opening a payment link shows the amount due and a mobile money payment option
A Customer can complete payment via mobile money without holding a bank account or card

requirements.statement: A Customer can pay a merchant's payment link using a card

criteria.must: Opening a payment link shows a card payment option
A Customer can complete payment by entering card details

requirements.statement: A Customer receives a confirmation of their payment

criteria.must: After a successful payment the customer sees a payment confirmation
The confirmation clearly serves as proof the payment went through

requirements.statement: A Merchant can see the status of a payment link (pending, paid, expired)

criteria.must: A newly created payment link shows status pending
A payment link that has been paid shows status paid
A payment link past its validity shows status expired

requirements.statement: A Merchant can view a running balance of funds collected

criteria.must: A Merchant can view their current available balance
The balance increases when a payment to that merchant completes

requirements.statement: A Merchant can view full transaction history with filters by date, status and payment method

criteria.must: A Merchant can view a list of their own transactions
The transaction list can be filtered by status
The transaction list can be filtered by payment method

requirements.statement: A Merchant can request a payout of their balance to a linked bank account or mobile money wallet

criteria.must: A Merchant can request a payout specifying an amount and destination (bank or mobile wallet)
A payout request cannot exceed the merchant's available balance

requirements.statement: A Merchant can see the status and history of their payout requests

criteria.must: A Merchant can view a list of their past payout requests with each one's status

requirements.statement: A Merchant can issue a full refund to a customer for a completed payment

criteria.must: A Merchant can initiate a refund on a completed transaction
A refund returns the full amount of the original payment to the original payment method
The platform does not offer a partial refund amount option

requirements.statement: A Platform Admin can view transactions and payouts across all merchants

criteria.must: A Platform Admin can view a list of transactions across all merchants
A Platform Admin can view a list of payouts across all merchants

requirements.statement: A Platform Admin can review and resolve escalated disputes or failed payouts

criteria.must: A Platform Admin can view a list of open disputes/failed payouts
A Platform Admin can mark a dispute as resolved with resolution notes

requirements.statement: Every user signs in via SSO through the platform identity provider

criteria.must: A Merchant must sign in before accessing merchant dashboard features
A Platform Admin must sign in before accessing the admin portal

requirements.statement: Each merchant transacts only in its own country's currency, with no cross-currency conversion

criteria.must: A merchant's payment links and transactions are always denominated in that merchant's own currency

requirements.statement: A payout is processed automatically once the merchant's balance and payout destination are verified, without requiring manual admin approval

criteria.must: A valid payout request is not blocked awaiting manual Platform Admin approval
Only a failed payout reaches the Platform Admin for resolution
